adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the added code path performs a refresh-token `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then immediately `await prisma.credential.update(...)` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`, with no conditional check (e.g., expiry) guarding it. As written, every invocation of this client-creation code will hit Salesforce’s token endpoint and write to the DB, which is a behavior change that can cause unnecessary refreshes and potential rate-limit/refresh-token churn.
